row.notes: Leaf case of the descriptor walk. Reads name (key 0x0fe07306), extends pathStr "%s.%s", reads type string (0x051897aa) and flag 0x47b0fbf7. For ordinary types creates a value object from the table's own type factory and reads key 0xd147f96a into it; for two special type names (0x145a72035, 0x145a71f54) packs the name into 16 bytes and takes the factory from the global list at 0x14612b950. Finds the child of *parentHandle by djb2(name); if missing creates it with FUN_1442b5760(alloc, parent, hash, flag, &value) and registers via FUN_1442b6740, else sets the value with func 0x1442133f0(handle, value, 5). Callback ctx+0x28 (user ctx+0x30) gets (handle, path). For the first special type it queues a deferred entry on *ctx (FUN_1443928b0) with the string value. Returns 0 or error (0x16, 3). Called from the three dispatch sites (Vm_Parse_DbTypeDescriptor, 0x1442b8fd0, 0x1442b9ef0) when the type string equals 0x145a71f42. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
